items.title: Frank Adams Interview, 1959-01-20
items.q: Robert Sarle pulled out his guns, put it on the quick. And as he put it on him, well the other one right, put it on that one. He's gone, he put it on four of them.

ctx.x: So then Robert Sarle pulled out his guns?
Robert Sarle pulled out his guns, put it on the quick. And as he put it on him, well the other one right, put it on that one. He's gone, he put it on four of them.
And he was gone. He got about four of them right there. Right there. Gone.
